title: ObjectState
description: Hub -> bus and Convex. Current belief about one registered object.

status.description: on_spot: resting on a spot (home or not). held: lifted from a spot and not yet placed. missing: never seen or lost. roaming: tracked by proximity (BLE).

last_seen_t.description: Unix seconds of the last observation; null if never seen.

source.description: Informational only. Nothing downstream may branch on it.

t.description: Unix seconds when this state was computed.

location.description: All fields optional/nullable. position is always filled when the hub can resolve one (spot, area, or receiver position).
